q: 明天下午我想___老师见面。
zh: 明天下午我想跟老师见面。
py: míng tiān xià wǔ wǒ xiǎng gēn lǎo shī jiàn miàn
en: I'd like to meet the teacher tomorrow afternoon.
why: 见面 already contains its object 面, so the teacher cannot follow it. 跟 brings the other person in before the verb; 见 or 把 or nothing leaves 老师 with no place in the sentence.

q: 他上个月___一个同事结婚了。
zh: 他上个月跟一个同事结婚了。
py: tā shàng gè yuè gēn yí gè tóng shì jié hūn le
en: He married a colleague last month.
why: 结婚 takes no object, so the partner is introduced by 跟 before the verb. 对, 把 and 给 do not mean 'together with' and cannot link the spouse to 结婚.

q: 你应该___经理道歉，因为你今天迟到了。
zh: 你应该向经理道歉，因为你今天迟到了。
py: nǐ yīng gāi xiàng jīng lǐ dào qiàn yīn wèi nǐ jīn tiān chí dào le
en: You should apologise to the manager, because you were late today.
why: 道歉 is verb plus object and cannot take 经理 after it. The person who receives the apology goes before the verb with 向. 把 and 被 change the structure instead of marking a recipient.

q: 经理明天要去___。
zh: 经理明天要去上海出差。
py: jīng lǐ míng tiān yào qù shàng hǎi chū chāi
en: The manager is going to Shanghai on a business trip tomorrow.
why: The place goes in front: 去上海出差. 出差 already holds its object 差, so a place name cannot sit right after it.

q: 你别___我的气了，好不好？
zh: 你别生我的气了，好不好？
py: nǐ bié shēng wǒ de qì le hǎo bù hǎo
en: Stop being angry with me, okay?
why: The person you are angry with goes inside 生气 as 我的: 生我的气. 生气 cannot be placed in front of 我的气 because 气 would then appear twice.

q: 谢谢你___我的忙，不然我今天做不完。
zh: 谢谢你帮了我的忙，不然我今天做不完。
py: xiè xiè nǐ bāng le wǒ de máng bù rán wǒ jīn tiān zuò bù wán
en: Thanks for helping me out, or I would not have finished today.
why: Splitting 帮忙 puts 了 after 帮 and the person with 的 before 忙: 帮了我的忙. 帮忙 whole cannot take 我的忙, and 帮助 never combines with 忙.

q: 老师还在生我___气呢。
zh: 老师还在生我的气呢。
py: lǎo shī hái zài shēng wǒ de qì ne
en: The teacher is still angry with me.
why: The person inside 生气 is linked to 气 by 的: 生我的气. 了, 着 or 地 cannot do that job between 我 and 气.

q: 同事们都很忙，没有人愿意___我的忙，我只好自己做完。
zh: 同事们都很忙，没有人愿意帮我的忙，我只好自己做完。
py: tóng shì men dōu hěn máng méi yǒu rén yuàn yì bāng wǒ de máng wǒ zhǐ hǎo zì jǐ zuò wán
en: My colleagues were all busy and nobody was willing to help me out, so I had to finish it myself.
why: Only the verb half 帮 can sit before 我的忙. 帮忙 or 帮忙了 would repeat 忙, and 帮助 takes a person directly but never the word 忙.

q: 小王工作很忙，我下班后去___他的忙。
zh: 小王工作很忙，我下班后去帮他的忙。
py: xiǎo wáng gōng zuò hěn máng wǒ xià bān hòu qù bāng tā de máng
en: Xiao Wang is busy at work, so I'm going to give him a hand after work.
why: 帮他的忙 is the standard shape for helping a person. 给 would need 给他帮忙 without 的, and 对 or 把 cannot make 忙 mean 'help'.

q: 他从来没请___假。
zh: 他从来没请过假。
py: tā cóng lái méi qǐng guo jià
en: He has never taken leave.
why: 'Never' (从来没) needs 过 for experience, and 过 attaches to the verb half: 请过假. 没请了假 is impossible, and 着 does not express past experience.

q: 我们以前见___面。
zh: 我们以前见过面。
py: wǒ men yǐ qián jiàn guo miàn
en: We have met before.
why: 过 marks 'has happened before' and sits right after 见: 见过面. 了 would make the sentence feel unfinished, and 着 or 的 cannot follow 见 here.

q: 他们坐在教室里，一边吃___饭，一边讨论问题。
zh: 他们坐在教室里，一边吃着饭，一边讨论问题。
py: tā men zuò zài jiào shì lǐ yī biān chī zhe fàn yī biān tǎo lùn wèn tí
en: They sat in the classroom, eating while discussing the problem.
why: Two actions at once: 着 goes after the verb 吃. 了 and 完 mark a completed action, and 过 means a past experience, so none of them fits 一边…一边.

q: 我吃___饭就去找你，你先在图书馆等我。
zh: 我吃了饭就去找你，你先在图书馆等我。
py: wǒ chī le fàn jiù qù zhǎo nǐ nǐ xiān zài tú shū guǎn děng wǒ
en: I'll come and find you as soon as I've eaten, so wait for me at the library first.
why: 吃饭 splits so that 了 follows the verb when a second action comes next: 吃了饭就去. 着, 得 and 地 do not mark the first of two sequential actions.

q: 他在这家公司工作了十年，从来没跟同事吵___架。
zh: 他在这家公司工作了十年，从来没跟同事吵过架。
py: tā zài zhè jiā gōng sī gōng zuò le shí nián cóng lái méi gēn tóng shì chǎo guo jià
en: He has worked at this company for ten years and has never quarrelled with a colleague.
why: With 从来没, experience 过 goes right after the verb 吵: 吵过架. 吵了架 and 吵着架 cannot follow 没, and 吵完架 would mean never finishing a fight.

q: 我昨天___。
zh: 我昨天睡了八个小时觉。
py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì le bā gè xiǎo shí jiào
en: I slept for eight hours yesterday.
why: The duration sits between the two halves, after 了: 睡了八个小时觉. 睡觉了八个小时 puts the amount after the whole word, which is not a pattern in Chinese.

q: 周末我们聊了一个下午___。
zh: 周末我们聊了一个下午的天。
py: zhōu mò wǒ men liáo le yí gè xià wǔ de tiān
en: At the weekend we chatted for a whole afternoon.
why: 聊天 splits into 聊 and 天, with the duration and 的 in between: 聊了一个下午的天. Repeating 聊天 afterwards would say the verb twice.

q: 他们结婚___了，现在还像刚认识一样。
zh: 他们结婚十年了，现在还像刚认识一样。
py: tā men jié hūn shí nián le xiàn zài hái xiàng gāng rèn shí yī yàng
en: They have been married for ten years and still behave as if they had just met.
why: 结婚 happens at a single point, so how long it has been goes after the whole word, followed by sentence-final 了: 结婚十年了. 结了十年婚 and 结婚了十年了 are both impossible.

q: 他离婚___了，现在一个人住。
zh: 他离婚三年了，现在一个人住。
py: tā lí hūn sān nián le xiàn zài yí gè rén zhù
en: He has been divorced for three years and now lives alone.
why: Like 结婚, 离婚 is a point-like event: time since goes after the whole word and 了 ends the sentence: 离婚三年了. Putting 了 or 过 before the time breaks that pattern.

q: 她昨天游泳游___一个小时。
zh: 她昨天游泳游了一个小时。
py: tā zuó tiān yóu yǒng yóu le yí gè xiǎo shí
en: She swam for an hour yesterday.
why: 游泳游了一个小时: the repeated verb takes 了 and the duration. 得 would start a description, 着 describes a continuing state, and 过 means 'has ever'.

q: 为了准备考试，他昨天晚上只睡___三个小时觉，今天一直没精神。
zh: 为了准备考试，他昨天晚上只睡了三个小时觉，今天一直没精神。
py: wèi le zhǔn bèi kǎo shì tā zuó tiān wǎn shàng zhǐ shuì le sān gè xiǎo shí jiào jīn tiān yì zhí méi jīng shén
en: To prepare for the exam he slept only three hours last night and has been lifeless all day.
why: Completed event with a duration: 了 goes after 睡 and before 三个小时觉. 着 and 得 do not mark a finished event, and 的 cannot follow the verb 睡.

q: 他生病了，所以向老师请___两天假。
zh: 他生病了，所以向老师请了两天假。
py: tā shēng bìng le suǒ yǐ xiàng lǎo shī qǐng le liǎng tiān jià
en: He was ill, so he asked the teacher for two days off.
why: 请了两天假: 了 sits inside the word before the duration. 请着两天假, 请得两天假 and 请地两天假 are not possible.

q: 我们只见过两___面。
zh: 我们只见过两次面。
py: wǒ men zhǐ jiàn guo liǎng cì miàn
en: We have only met twice.
why: The number of times goes inside 见面 after 过: 见过两次面. 个 counts things, not occasions, and 本 and 天 do not mean 'times'.

q: 他结过两___婚，现在一个人住。
zh: 他结过两次婚，现在一个人住。
py: tā jié guo liǎng cì hūn xiàn zài yí gè rén zhù
en: He has been married twice and now lives alone.
why: 次 counts occurrences and sits inside 结婚 after 过: 结过两次婚. 年 would be a duration, and 个 or 件 cannot count marriages here.

q: 我想先洗___澡，再吃饭。
zh: 我想先洗个澡，再吃饭。
py: wǒ xiǎng xiān xǐ gè zǎo zài chī fàn
en: I'd like to take a shower first, and then eat.
why: The casual 个 goes inside 洗澡 and makes the action sound light: 洗个澡. 次, 张 and 本 do not fit 澡.

q: 你能不能帮我一___忙？
zh: 你能不能帮我一个忙？
py: nǐ néng bù néng bāng wǒ yí gè máng
en: Could you do me a favour?
why: 帮我一个忙 is the set phrase: the person goes right after 帮 and 个 goes between the halves. 件 or 次 cannot count 忙.

q: 我下午想去理___发。
zh: 我下午想去理个发。
py: wǒ xià wǔ xiǎng qù lǐ gè fā
en: I want to go and get a haircut this afternoon.
why: 个 goes inside 理发 and makes it casual: 理个发. 张, 本 and 把 cannot be put between 理 and 发.

q: 他们只见过一___面，就决定在下个月结婚。
zh: 他们只见过一次面，就决定在下个月结婚。
py: tā men zhǐ jiàn guo yī cì miàn jiù jué dìng zài xià gè yuè jié hūn
en: They had met only once before deciding to marry next month.
why: The number of times belongs inside the word after 过: 见过一次面. 个, 本 and 件 do not count occasions.

q: 吃完饭，我们去公园___吧。
zh: 吃完饭，我们去公园散散步吧。
py: chī wán fàn wǒ men qù gōng yuán sàn sàn bù ba
en: After eating, let's go for a little walk in the park.
why: Only the verb half doubles: 散散步. 步 is the object, so repeating the whole word 散步散步 is wrong.

q: 周末你有空吗？来我家___吧。
zh: 周末你有空吗？来我家聊聊天吧。
py: zhōu mò nǐ yǒu kòng ma lái wǒ jiā liáo liáo tiān ba
en: Are you free at the weekend? Come over to my place for a chat.
why: 聊聊天 doubles only 聊. The whole word 聊天 is verb plus object, and does not double like 休息.

q: 这件事我一个人做不完，请你___吧。
zh: 这件事我一个人做不完，请你帮帮忙吧。
py: zhè jiàn shì wǒ yí gè rén zuò bù wán qǐng nǐ bāng bāng máng ba
en: I can't finish this by myself, so please lend a hand.
why: The verb half doubles: 帮帮忙. 帮忙帮忙 treats 帮忙 as a single two-syllable verb, which it is not.

q: 考试以前太紧张了，我想出去___，放松一下。
zh: 考试以前太紧张了，我想出去跑跑步，放松一下。
py: kǎo shì yǐ qián tài jǐn zhāng le wǒ xiǎng chū qù pǎo pǎo bù fàng sōng yī xià
en: I was so nervous before the exam that I want to go out for a little run to relax.
why: Double only the verb: 跑跑步. 步 is an object and cannot repeat with the verb.

q: 昨天晚上我们在宿舍里___，一点儿也不累。
zh: 昨天晚上我们在宿舍里聊了聊天，一点儿也不累。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shàng wǒ men zài sù shè lǐ liáo le liáo tiān yì diǎn ér yě bù lèi
en: Last night we had a little chat in the dormitory and were not tired at all.
why: In a finished doubled action 了 goes between the two verbs and the object follows: 聊了聊天. 聊天了聊 breaks the word apart in the wrong place.

q: 她唱歌___很好听。
zh: 她唱歌唱得很好听。
py: tā chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo tīng
en: She sings beautifully.
why: 得 must follow a verb, so 唱 is repeated after 唱歌: 唱歌唱得很好听. 唱歌得 puts 得 after a noun, and 的 or 着 give no degree.

q: 我哥哥游泳游___很快。
zh: 我哥哥游泳游得很快。
py: wǒ gē gē yóu yǒng yóu de hěn kuài
en: My older brother swims very fast.
why: After 游泳 the verb 游 repeats, then 得 introduces the description: 游得很快. 了 and 着 would mark aspect, and 的 cannot join a verb to its result.

q: 她舞___非常好，老师都夸她。
zh: 她舞跳得非常好，老师都夸她。
py: tā wǔ tiào de fēi cháng hǎo lǎo shī dōu kuā tā
en: She dances extremely well, and the teacher praises her.
why: With the object 舞 first, the verb appears once before 得: 舞跳得非常好. 跳了 only reports a finished act, and bare 得 or 的 cannot sit after the noun 舞.

q: 昨晚我睡觉___太晚了，今天很累。
zh: 昨晚我睡觉睡得太晚了，今天很累。
py: zuó wǎn wǒ shuì jiào shuì de tài wǎn le jīn tiān hěn lèi
en: I went to bed far too late last night, so I'm tired today.
why: 睡觉 repeats its verb before 得: 睡觉睡得太晚了. 得 straight after 觉 does not work, because 觉 is a noun, and 睡了 lacks the description.

q: 我同学唱歌唱___不好，可是她特别喜欢参加比赛。
zh: 我同学唱歌唱得不好，可是她特别喜欢参加比赛。
py: wǒ tóng xué chàng gē chàng de bù hǎo kě shì tā tè bié xǐ huān cān jiā bǐ sài
en: My classmate does not sing well, but she really likes to enter competitions.
why: 得 comes right after the repeated verb 唱 and introduces the negative description 不好. 的, 了 and 地 cannot link a verb to its result.

q: 我吃___饭就去上课。
zh: 我吃完饭就去上课。
py: wǒ chī wán fàn jiù qù shàng kè
en: I'll go to class as soon as I've finished eating.
why: The result word 完 goes right after 吃 and before 饭: 吃完饭. 吃到饭 would mean 'managed to get a meal'.

q: 昨天晚上太吵了，我没睡___觉。
zh: 昨天晚上太吵了，我没睡好觉。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shàng tài chǎo le wǒ méi shuì hǎo jiào
en: Last night was so noisy that I didn't sleep well.
why: 没睡好觉: 好 is the result complement between the halves of 睡觉. 对, 去 and 给 do not describe how well one slept.

q: 我最近很担心考试，晚上总是睡___觉。
zh: 我最近很担心考试，晚上总是睡不着觉。
py: wǒ zuì jìn hěn dān xīn kǎo shì wǎn shàng zǒng shì shuì bù zháo jiào
en: I've been worrying about the exam, and I can never fall asleep at night.
why: The potential 不着 sits after 睡 and before 觉: 睡不着觉. 睡着不觉 puts the pieces in the wrong order and 没着 is not a result form.

q: 你到底生___气？说出来吧。
zh: 你到底生什么气？说出来吧。
py: nǐ dào dǐ shēng shén me qì shuō chū lái ba
en: What exactly are you angry about? Say it out loud.
why: The question word goes inside the word: 生什么气. 怎么, 哪 and 为 cannot follow the verb 生 and take 气.

q: 上___课，我们一起去操场打篮球吧。
zh: 上完课，我们一起去操场打篮球吧。
py: shàng wán kè wǒ men yì qǐ qù cāo chǎng dǎ lán qiú ba
en: Let's play basketball on the sports field together after class.
why: 'After class finishes' needs the result word 完 inside 上课: 上完课. 着 describes ongoing class, and 了 or 过 do not mean 'having finished'.

q: 他每天忙到半夜，常常洗___澡就倒在床上睡着了。
zh: 他每天忙到半夜，常常洗完澡就倒在床上睡着了。
py: tā měi tiān máng dào bàn yè cháng cháng xǐ wán zǎo jiù dào zài chuáng shàng shuì zháo le
en: He is busy until midnight every day and often falls asleep on the bed as soon as he has finished his shower.
why: 完 goes after 洗 and before 澡: 洗完澡. 着, 过 and 得 do not mean 'finished'.

zh: 我想跟老师见面。
py: wǒ xiǎng gēn lǎo shī jiàn miàn
en: I'd like to meet the teacher.
why: The teacher goes before the verb with 跟, and 见面 comes last. 见面老师 is impossible because 见面 already has an object.

zh: 小王跟一个同事结婚了。
py: xiǎo wáng gēn yí gè tóng shì jié hūn le
en: Xiao Wang married a colleague.
why: The spouse comes after 跟 and before 结婚. 结婚 cannot take the colleague as an object, so 结婚一个同事 fails.

zh: 我应该向她道歉。
py: wǒ yīng gāi xiàng tā dào qiàn
en: I should apologise to her.
why: 向 plus the person goes before 道歉. 道歉她 is wrong because 歉 already is the object.

zh: 谢谢你帮了我的忙。
py: xiè xiè nǐ bāng le wǒ de máng
en: Thank you for helping me out.
why: The person sits inside the word as 我的: 帮了我的忙. 帮忙 whole cannot be followed by 我.

zh: 妈妈还在生我的气。
py: mā mā hái zài shēng wǒ de qì
en: Mum is still angry with me.
why: 生我的气: the person who is the target goes inside 生气 with 的. 生气我 is impossible.

zh: 我们以前见过面。
py: wǒ men yǐ qián jiàn guo miàn
en: We have met before.
why: 过 attaches to the verb 见, and 面 follows: 见过面. 见面过 puts 过 on the noun half.

zh: 他从来没请过假。
py: tā cóng lái méi qǐng guo jià
en: He has never taken leave.
why: 没 + verb + 过 + object: 没请过假. 过 stays on 请, so 没请假过 fails.

zh: 我昨天睡了八个小时觉。
py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì le bā gè xiǎo shí jiào
en: I slept for eight hours yesterday.
why: 了 and the duration go inside 睡觉: 睡了八个小时觉. 睡觉了八个小时 is wrong.

zh: 他们离婚已经三年了。
py: tā men lí hūn yǐ jīng sān nián le
en: They have been divorced for three years.
why: 离婚 is a point-like event, so time since follows the whole word and 了 closes it: 离婚三年了. 离了三年婚 is wrong.

zh: 为了准备考试他昨天只睡了四个小时觉。
py: wèi le zhǔn bèi kǎo shì tā zuó tiān zhǐ shuì le sì gè xiǎo shí jiào
en: To prepare for the exam he slept only four hours yesterday.
why: 睡了四个小时觉: 了 and the duration come between 睡 and 觉. 觉 is last, and 只 stays before the verb.

zh: 我们只见过两次面。
py: wǒ men zhǐ jiàn guo liǎng cì miàn
en: We have only met twice.
why: 两次 goes inside 见面 after 过: 见过两次面. 见面过两次 is the classic wrong order.

zh: 经理今天开了三个会。
py: jīng lǐ jīn tiān kāi le sān gè huì
en: The manager held three meetings today.
why: The count goes inside 开会 after 了: 开了三个会. 开会了三个 is wrong.

zh: 我想先洗个澡。
py: wǒ xiǎng xiān xǐ gè zǎo
en: I'd like to take a shower first.
why: 个 goes between 洗 and 澡 for a casual single action: 洗个澡. 洗澡个 is impossible.

zh: 周末我喜欢在家唱唱歌。
py: zhōu mò wǒ xǐ huān zài jiā chàng chàng gē
en: At weekends I like to sing a bit at home.
why: Only 唱 doubles: 唱唱歌. 唱歌唱歌 repeats the object as well.

zh: 有空来我家聊聊天。
py: yǒu kòng lái wǒ jiā liáo liáo tiān
en: Drop by my place for a chat when you have time.
why: 聊聊天: the first half doubles and 天 stays single. 聊天聊天 is wrong.

zh: 昨天我睡觉睡得很晚。
py: zuó tiān wǒ shuì jiào shuì de hěn wǎn
en: I went to bed very late yesterday.
